description: Implementation of SHA1 hashing algorithm optimized for word access, based on Mozilla's SHA1 code, including functions for initializing, updating, and finalizing SHA1 hashes.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Init
methods.description: Initializes SHA1 context with standard constants.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Update
methods.description: Updates SHA1 hash with new data, processing in 64-byte blocks.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Final
methods.description: Finalizes the SHA1 hash, producing the 20-byte digest.
